title: Loran Recovers the Sylex from Terisia City
summary: Before Argoth’s destruction, Loran salvages the Golgothian Sylex, bringing a Thran-era weapon back into the war’s final sequence.
narrative: The Golgothian Sylex did not materialize for Urza at the instant of the final battle. In the published story chronology, Loran recovered the Sylex from Terisia City while the conflict between Urza and Mishra continued to devastate Terisiare.

This act of preservation also delivered a terrible possibility: the ancient device would ultimately become the instrument of Urza’s decision on Argoth. Loran’s recovery is therefore a distinct historical event, while the later activation and its consequences remain recorded separately.
Urza’s Sylex is the already-curated retrospective card used here to identify the artifact. Its artwork is not asserted to depict Loran recovering it in Terisia City.
